tools.name: preflight
tools.description: Validate whether a structured authority envelope contains enough explicit constraints for ScopeProof to evaluate one action. Free. Returns no substantive authorization verdict and accepts no credentials, raw prompts, arbitrary request bodies, or secrets.

tools.description: Determine whether one proposed action is within explicitly supplied authority. $0.01 stablecoin machine payment. tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify the cryptographic integrity of one ScopeProof receipt without exposing the server signing key. Free and repeatable.
